hq_country: India (Chennai, Tamil Nadu); US HQ in Austin, Texas
target_vertical: Multi-channel retailer, wholesaler, light manufacturer, DTC brand
pricing_model: Tiered per-organization monthly subscription with order volume and user/warehouse limits per tier; annual or monthly billing
starting_price_usd: $29/month (Standard, billed annually) or $39/month billed monthly; Free plan available (50 orders/month)
free_trial_or_freemium: 14-day free trial of paid plans; permanent Free plan with 50 orders/month, 1 user, 2 warehouses
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional for inventory and orders: orders flow Shopify -> Zoho Inventory; stock updates flow Zoho Inventory -> Shopify; items can be fetched either direction depending on configuration
shopify_synced_entities: Products/items, variants (via SKU/name mapping), inventory (aggregated across warehouses to a single Shopify location by default), sales orders, customers/contacts, shipment status (fulfillment updates back to Shopify)
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - multiple Shopify stores can be connected to a single Zoho Inventory organization
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Items mapped by SKU or item name; warehouse mapping configurable per Shopify store
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Configurable sync frequency; orders import on schedule and stock sync triggered on inventory changes; not purely event-driven webhook architecture
shopify_known_limitations: Stock is aggregated across all Zoho warehouses to one Shopify location quantity by default; item mapping limitations between Shopify variants and Zoho composite/assembly items; sync configuration complexity reported in community forums; monthly order limits on each plan tier can throttle Shopify volumes
etsy_native_or_third_party: Native direct Etsy integration (Settings > Integrations > Marketplace > Etsy); third-party connectors (Commercium, CedCommerce) also available
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync existing listings; listing creation in Etsy from Zoho Inventory is [uncertain]
etsy_inventory_sync: Automatic stock-level updates across channels when sales occur; sync requires matching base currency between Zoho Inventory and Etsy
etsy_order_import: Automatic import of Etsy orders as sales orders in Zoho Inventory with customer details mapped by email
etsy_synced_entities: Listings (sync), inventory/stock levels, orders (as sales orders), customer contacts, shipment status (carrier/tracking pushed back to Etsy)
etsy_known_limitations: [uncertain] - documented limits around variations/personalization/digital products not detailed in Zoho help center
amazon_marketplaces: US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Australia, India (varies by Zoho region edition); [uncertain] full marketplace list
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM (Seller Fulfilled) both supported; Vendor Central support is [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory/stock, sales orders, shipments, returns; FBA inbound shipments can be created from POs or transfer orders; settlement/payment data sync [uncertain]
amazon_listing_creation: Primarily syncs existing listings; advanced listing creation from Zoho Inventory is [uncertain]
amazon_repricing_support: Not included natively; would require third-party repricer
amazon_buy_shipping: [uncertain] - Buy Shipping API integration not documented
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA inbound shipments can be created in Zoho Inventory after creating a Purchase Order or Transfer Order; FBA locations mapped to Zoho Inventory locations for accurate stock tracking
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: [uncertain] - migration status to v2024-03-20 inbound API not publicly disclosed
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] - automated settlement report parsing and journaling to accounting not documented; appears to focus on order-level sync
amazon_known_limitations: Order volume limits per plan tier; settlement reconciliation tooling appears limited compared to Amazon-specialist tools (A2X, Link My Books); deeper Amazon-specific workflows often require third-party connectors (Commercium, APIWORX)
xero_synced_entities: Chart of Accounts (imported from Xero), customers and vendors (from Xero into Zoho Inventory), invoices and bills (exported from Zoho Inventory to Xero), payments; items do NOT sync automatically
xero_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - individual invoices and bills exported from Zoho Inventory to Xero
xero_cogs_journal_method: [uncertain] - Zoho Inventory uses FIFO internally for COGS but how this posts to Xero is not clearly documented
xero_known_limitations: Items do not sync automatically between Zoho Inventory and Xero - must be exported from Xero and manually imported into Zoho Inventory; changes to items in Zoho Inventory are not reflected back in Xero; community reports note that any non-Zoho-Books accounting integration is harder to maintain
qb_desktop_supported: [uncertain] - QuickBooks Desktop direct integration not documented in current Zoho material
qb_app_certified: Listed on Intuit App Store / QuickBooks app marketplace
qb_synced_entities: Accounts, customers, vendors (imported from QBO); invoices, credit notes, bills with payments (exported from Zoho Inventory to QBO); items do NOT sync automatically
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - individual invoices, bills, credit notes pushed to QBO
qb_cogs_journal_method: [uncertain] - Zoho Inventory uses FIFO internally; precise journal posting method to QBO is not documented
qb_known_limitations: Items do not sync to/from QuickBooks Online - must import existing items from QBO into Zoho Inventory which then becomes the master; accounts sync is one-way (changes in Zoho do not flow back to QBO); daily auto-sync (with manual Instant Sync option) rather than real-time event-driven
other_ecom_channels: Native: Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce. Via Zoho ecosystem/partners (Commercium, CedCommerce, SKUPlugs): BigCommerce, Magento, Wix, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Lazada, Farfetch, OnBuy, Mirakl, Noon, Temu, Shein, Kogan, Flipkart, Reverb and 200+ others
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes - via Composite Items: Assemblies (formerly Bundles) physically assemble components into a finished good, decrementing component stock and incrementing assembly stock; Kit Items group items for sale without physical assembly. Non-inventory items and services can be associated as constituents
other_accounting_integrations: Zoho Books (native, deepest integration), QuickBooks Online (native), Xero (native). Other accounting platforms (Sage, MYOB, NetSuite, FreshBooks, Wave) are [uncertain] for native support; typically via third-party connectors or Zoho Flow
bom_support: Yes - via Composite Items (Assemblies/Bundles) which act as a BOM-equivalent; Zoho ERP adds more manufacturing modules
multi_level_bom: [uncertain] - true multi-level/nested BOMs are limited in Zoho Inventory; Zoho ERP/Books advanced inventory may support deeper levels
production_orders: Limited - bundling/assembly transactions decrement components and create finished goods; full work orders with routings/operations are not in core Zoho Inventory (handled by Zoho ERP Manufacturing modules)
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - batch number tracking with expiry available on Professional plan and above
serial_tracking: Yes - serial number tracking available on Professional plan and above; scannable serials for inbound/outbound
bin_location_support: [uncertain] - sub-location/bin tracking within a warehouse is not a documented core feature; multi-warehouse is supported but bin-level less so
multi_warehouse: Yes - multiple warehouses supported (limits scale with plan tier; Enterprise unlocks higher counts)
barcoding: Yes - free built-in barcode generator (EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF), label printing, QR code generation, and barcode scanning in transactions
purchase_orders: Yes - POs with partial receipts, vendor management, drop-shipping, backorders, and conversion to bills
supplier_management: Yes - vendor records, vendor credits, preferred vendor per item; lead times and MOQs [uncertain] in core Inventory
landed_cost_support: Yes - landed costs (freight, customs, shipping, insurance) can be added to bills and allocated to line items proportionately by value or quantity
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Multi-currency transactions supported per contact; per-currency inventory valuation vs single base currency is [uncertain]
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes - Zia AI provides sales trend predictions based on historical order data, dynamic reorder-level suggestions, and low-stock alerts (requires several weeks of order history)
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Reorder-level suggestions adjusted by Zia forecasts; full auto-generated PO drafts are [uncertain]
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] - chat-style ask-your-inventory is part of broader Zia/Zoho ERP roadmap but not confirmed as a shipped Zoho Inventory feature
public_api: REST API - well-documented (zoho.com/inventory/api/v1), OAuth 2.0, covers items, contacts, sales/purchase orders, invoices, bills, warehouses, etc.
webhook_event_coverage: Both incoming webhooks (third-party -> Zoho Inventory via Deluge functions) and outgoing webhooks (Zoho Inventory -> third-party via configurable HTTP methods) supported through Zoho's automation framework
integration_architecture: Native (vendor-built connectors for Shopify/Amazon/Etsy/eBay/WooCommerce/QBO/Xero/Zoho Books) supplemented by Zoho Flow (iPaaS) and a partner ecosystem (Commercium, CedCommerce, SKUPlugs) for long-tail channels
zapier_make_support: Yes - Zapier and Zoho Flow connectors; Make support [uncertain]
mobile_app: Yes - native iOS and Android apps for order, inventory and warehouse management on the go
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes - mobile camera barcode scanning for items, serial numbers and transactions in the iOS/Android app
rate_limit_handling_documented: Zoho Inventory API documents its own rate limits (e.g., per-org/day call limits by plan); how the app internally handles Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO rate limits is [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Configurable per channel; orders typically near-real-time or scheduled; QuickBooks Online auto-syncs daily with manual Instant Sync; Shopify/Amazon/Etsy sync frequency selectable in settings
shipping_carrier_integrations: Native US/Canada carriers: USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL Express; international via EasyPost aggregator (FedEx, DHL, Royal Mail, etc.); other regional carriers vary by Zoho edition
shipping_label_buying: Yes - in-app shipping label purchase via EasyPost and direct US/Canada carrier integrations
three_pl_integrations: [uncertain] - native 3PL integrations (ShipBob, ShipHero, Extensiv) appear primarily via Zapier/Zoho Flow or partner connectors rather than first-party
edi_support: [uncertain] - native EDI not documented; typically via third-party
capterra_rating: [uncertain] - listed on Capterra but exact star rating/review count not confirmed in current results
last_major_release: Enhanced Composite Items, expanded Zia AI forecasting and broader Zoho ERP / AI ecosystem integration through 2025-2026; exact dated release [uncertain]
owner_parent_company: Zoho Corporation (privately held, bootstrapped, founded 1996 by Sridhar Vembu and Tony Thomas as AdventNet)
last_funding_event: None - Zoho Corporation is bootstrapped and privately held; no external funding rounds or acquisitions reported
public_status_page_uptime: https://status.zoho.com (also zohostatus.com) - per-product component statuses including Zoho Inventory; exact recent uptime % [uncertain]
